posts.text: I do want to clarify that this isn’t a complaint. I just want people to know why I do this even tho I don’t love it. But life isn’t about only doing things you love. For me, it’s about what I can live with myself with. And I wouldn’t be able to live with myself knowing that I could’ve helped someone and I chose not to. For me, it’s about being the person I wish to see in the world. I’m not perfect, I don’t claim to be. But that’s not gonna stop me from working hard to better myself and do what I

To the people who blindly defended a man they don’t fully know, you are a big part of the reason why the women and business victims did not feel safe and were too scared to come forward speaking up against @BAP ROSS. And reminder, a person’s character isn’t based off the person they present to you in the light, but how they act when they think no one is watching or to someone they think no one cares about - THAT defines a person’s character. It’s not just restaurants, the owner of Scxm Studios had to essentially pay $$ so Yox could make their merch to sell. Bc @BAP ROSS didn’t even fully reimburse him, let alone pay him his share of the profits. That’s making someone work not even for free, but making them pay for your benefit. That’s not a mistake. #rickyox #yearoftheox #yox #bapross #scam

@BAP ROSS is claiming he does this for the love of the community but another restaurant that was struggling that gave him $800 worth of free food and Rick ghosted them. And made the promoter lose his client, acknowledged that happened BECAUSE of him and STILL CHOSE to screw over the promoter. This isn’t a mistake. This is a pattern of behavior of taking advantage of those who are already in a bad place. That’s an active choice Rick had to make everytime he lied, everytime he didn’t follow thru,

@BAP ROSS taking more accountability on camera than you did in your correspondence to them along with the fact that you make this video BEFORE making it right with your victims does not make this seem genuine; it seems like PR. #bapross #rickyox #scam #asianownedsmallbusiness #losangeles

There is absolutely no scenario where you don’t deliver on a signed contract for almost a year and block your clients who already paid you unless it was intentional. There is literally no acceptable scenario where you promise “I’ll post it tomorrow” multiple times and then don’t respond and then block them unless it’s on purpose. So no, we don’t need to hear Rick’s side other than taking accountability. And from what I hear he’s deleting comments… so the literal opposite. #rickyox #bapross #rick
